title: Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement Fee Schedule: Short-Notice Extension Surcharge
content:
| Extension request registered before the planned departure date on record | Short-notice surcharge per added night |
|---|---|
| 3 days or fewer | 15.00 USD |
| 4 to 7 days | 8.00 USD |
| 8 days or more | None |

**Schedule note.** The short-notice surcharge per added night on an extension under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is fifteen dollars when the extension request was registered three or fewer days before the planned departure date on record, eight dollars when it was registered four to seven days before, and nothing when it was registered earlier.

**Counting the notice.** The days of notice are the planned departure date on record less the date the extension request was registered, in calendar days. A request registered on the planned departure date has 0 days of notice; one registered after it has fewer than 0; both fall in the 3-days-or-fewer row.

**How it is charged.** The surcharge is added to the extension charge as the added nights times the surcharge per added night, the added nights being every night from the planned departure date on record up to the requested date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, planned departure date 20 May on record)

| Request registered | Days of notice | Surcharge per added night |
|---|---|---|
| 17 May | 3 | 15.00 |
| 16 May | 4 | 8.00 |
| 13 May | 7 | 8.00 |
| 12 May | 8 | None |

## Hypothetical illustration

A request registered on 18 May for 5 added nights carries 5 times 15.00, that is 75.00 of surcharge.
